outcome: The Lab's appearance rules now live in style files instead of JavaScript, with pixel-identical pages
owner_impact: Nothing looks different. The appearance rules that 13 parts of the Lab used to write into the page from JavaScript now live, unchanged, in 13 ordinary style files that the page loads directly, in the same order as before. Before/after captures at phone, foldable, desktop and ultra-wide sizes are pixel-identical, and every one of the roughly 900 page elements has exactly the same computed style and position. Styles are now present from the first moment instead of appearing as each part loads.

next.text: Next is #545 — behaviour tests for Experiment revisions and the Working copy: the revision rules will be moved into a small separate module with tests that check what happens, not how the code is written, preparing the later split of the largest file. #545 has not started.

technical_evidence: 13 injected <style> blocks moved verbatim (dedented) into web/src/styles/*.css; showcase-professor-placement.js removed; results-ui.css is now a static link at its former position.

index.html links the moved stylesheets after a vlab:react-stylesheet marker in the former runtime order (results-ui, result-persistence, registry, library, registration, onboarding, showcase, touch targets, authoring, collections, management, ui-clarity, inbox, development links); build.mjs inserts the React stylesheet at the marker; verify-dist checks versioned links and order.

New web/scripts/style-snapshot.mjs (computed style and box of every body element plus full-page screenshots at four viewports, with an offline library mirror option); the shared smoke harness gained an optional event subscription.

Before/after capture comparison identical at all four viewports (885-913 elements, screenshots byte-identical); three captures of the unchanged build were identical; a planted 1px padding change was detected.
Source-text tests read moved CSS through tests/support/source-with-styles.mjs; tests/styles-in-css.test.mjs forbids <style> injection and pins link order.
